line.comment: * Wait for starting options to be answered.
* Also wait for full generation of the galaxy.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Cleanup - move difficulty and other permanent read-only variables above here.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Centralized xenon grace period time. Now uses the Xenon small cycle time as SSOT.
* Sector alerts.
* Claim expiration. Add-Ons 2.0.4 (comments only): Not affected by extra support perk or foreign docks.
* Truce expiration.
* Expanded 2.2: Player pacts are handled through their SSOT.
* Invalid truce entries have no start time.
* The normal truce must expire before a player pact matters.
* Terracorp introduction message. * Zero Hour 2.0 - changed into general tutorial message
* Add-Ons 1.3: No tutorial on insane.
* Galaxy expansion none tutorial message, and black market message.
* Herobetty 5.1: Fixed message displayed after 24 hours instead of after 12 hours. This was a bug since base Mayhem 3.21b.
* Add-Ons 1.11: Nation status opens the market.
* Hive Queen.
* Herobetty 5.1: Hive queens return to origin galaxies but only after 24 hours have passed.
* Add-Ons 2.1: Updated argument for Kha'ak raid spawn.
* Add-Ons 2.1: Kha'ak quest progression.
* Quest completed!
* Expanded 2.2: Temporarily protected abandoned ships become claimable by NPCs/tugs after their grace period expires.
* Note: Global array pointer; removals apply in place.
* Handle Xenon invasions.
* ZH: disabled for a while after the Xenon Crisis (2 8-hour cycles)
* Look for beacons first. If there are no beacons, choose Xenon Stations and the portal.
* Check previous invasion group's leaders to see if they are alive, and assess the number of groups.
* The invasion limit is 3.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Xenon have been overhauled to focus more on defense. OCV focus more on offense.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Grace period is now 24 hours (was 48).
* Check if any small groups have been eliminated.
* Not very accurate because we only check the leader, but it's enough.
* Check if any large groups have been eliminated.
* Not very accurate because we only check the leader, but it's enough.
* 2 hour grace period from gamestart before spawning.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Now check sector if station exists. Also moved big Xenon timeout refresher to just before committing to the spawn.
* Small invasions prefer Jump Beacons, then Xenon Stations and the portal.
* Big invasions
* ZH 1.6: big invasion is no longer guaranteed to spawn at a Jump Beacon. Can spawn from either Jump Beacons or Xenon Stations.
* End 2 hour check
* End Xenon timeout check
* End Xenon Station check
* End post-Crisis grace period
* Favor timeouts.
* Priority targets (diplomacy).
* Add-Ons 2.2: Cannot be Phanon. Asterisk is now colored to denote whose priority target.
* Cannot be a priority target assigned by the player or Phanon (Phanon does not require Favor Points).
* Keep the current target while it remains valid.
* Keep the target only while ownership and hostilities (with the original owner) remain unchanged.
* Target is no longer valid. Restore its original name and clear the mark.
* Target is dead. Clear the priority target and select a new one.
* Faction needs an Outpost before it can assign a priority target.
* Randomize enemy search order. Only Commonwealth factions can be selected.
* Priority targets are M7s assigned to major military operations.
* Must still be alive.
* Candidate must still be under current ownership.
* Must be in a battle group, border patrol, rearguard, or task force squadron. Does not have to be the leader.
* A ship can only be one faction's priority target.
* Found a target within all M7s.
* Found a target within this enemy faction.
* No eligible priority target was found.
* Found a valid target.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Color denotes which faction assigned the priority target.
* Should never happen.
* End priority target selection.
* Safety: remove coalitions when needed. Even though coalitions are updated at each conquer, sometimes a coalition cannot be properly removed.
* Mordan8
* Unlock, or lock the Teladi Stock exchange depending on player notoriety with them.
* 3333 notoriety is reputation level 6 (close ally on easy, normal, hard).
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Must be a close friend, i.e. rank 7 on insane. Also cleaned up code by getting the station's owner (futureproofing).
* To make the game more dynamic, we check if possible coalitions are possible every 12 hours.
* Mordan9
* Every 20 minutes, there's a chance the A.I. races will remove your satellites.
* Chance improves with harder difficulty level. Enabled in 9973.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Chance is 50% on insane. (1.13.1: Threshold now determined before iterating through both AI-to-player and player-to-AI loops.)
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: Fixed off-by-1 error (now random from zero to 99 rather than to 100).
* Add-Ons 1.14: Now a required modifier on insane.
* Defaults: 3333 rep and 20% chance. Modifed by difficulty.
* easy
* medium
* hard
* insane
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Apply global chance modifiers once; per-sector notoriety modifiers use $satChance.
* Player Infamy adds another 10%
* Get array of all player satellites
* Notoriety level 6 (7 on insane) will allow your satellites to be untouched.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Reputation rank 7 is required on insane.
* Add-Ons 1.13: A permanent war ensures satellites are never safe.
* negative notoriety adds 10% additional chance for your satellite to be taken down.
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: Show a tutorial when the first player satellite is removed. Many people had asked why they were being removed.
* No tutorial on insane - it doesn't explain plot progression or galaxy changes.
* Display the player's current rank in the message.
* end while $satiterator
* Now remove any A.I. satellites from player space, assuming relations are not great. Fixed 35% chance per sector.
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: Don't use a magic number for rep. The threshold is based on difficulty.
* end while $itty
* Must not be Huge ships.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Consolidated xenonDifficulty into difficulty.
* Easy: Downgrade all LX to L. -2 M3 and -1 M6 from Normal.
* Normal: Baseline.
* Hard: Upgrade all L to LX. +2 M3 and +1 M6 from Normal.
* Insane: Upgrade all P to PX. +4 M3 from Hard.
* OCV-aligned Insane: Normal strength.
* Add-Ons 2.2: All big fleets now include a carrier, replacing one of the M2+.
* Reduced M7 quantity by 1 to emphasize Xenon's invasion fleets as secondary role.
* Difficulty now affects fleet quantity and quality.
* Easy: Downgrades the M2+ to K. -1 Q from Normal.
* Normal: Baseline. Chooses a random M2+.
* Hard: Upgrades the Q to a C or an H. +1 C from Normal.
* The bonus M7 is either another C or an H.
* Insane: Upgrades all C to G (significantly tougher than C). The H is guaranteed.
* OCV-aligned Insane: Normal strength.
* On Hard and Insane, support types are upgraded to LX.
* Add-Ons 2.2: All ships gain missiles. Xenon use underpowered M6/M7 and desperately need the damage.
* Add-Ons 2.2: This script sets the invader flag.
* For Xenon invasions, the baseline is a 150 size galaxy.
* Xenon remain more aggressive on higher difficulties,
* Add-Ons 2.2: territorial growth primarily strengthens their garrisons rather than accelerating invasions.
* Hard: -20% duration (25% faster).
* Insane: -33% duration (50% faster).
* Safety. Never go below 10 min
